1.name: Diorite and gabbro
1.description: Occurs as generally small, irregular-shaped bodies throughout map area. Some bodies older and some younger than the plutonic rocks with which they are in contact

2.name: Alluvium
2.description: Stream deposits in major valleys and upland meadow areas; locally includes alluvial  fan deposits on the margins of major valleys and glacial outwash deposits

3.name: Half Dome Granodiorite
3.description: Medium-grained biotite-hornblende granodiorite with conspicuous sphene. Locally porphyritic with abundant large phenocrysts of potassium feldspar

4.name: Pre-Tahoe Till
4.description: Moraines hummocky and dissected. Includes till mapped by some as Sherwin Till east of the Sierra Nevada crest

5.name: Talus
5.description: Rock waste derived from cliffs. Only especially extensive areas shown

6.name: Sentinel Granodiorite
6.description: Coarse-grained, dark-gray, biotite-hornblende granodiorite with abundant sphene. Age about 93 Ma (K-Ar)

7.name: Granodiorite of Kuna Crest and similar rocks
7.description: Dark-colored, fine- to medium-grained, biotite-hornblende granodiorite with minor tonalite. Age about 88 Ma (U-Pb)

8.name: Taft Granite and similar rocks
8.description: Fine- to coarse-grained white to gray biotite granite and biotite granodiorite. Locally porphyritic with phenocrysts of potassium feldspar. Age about 96 Ma (U-Pb)

9.name: El Capitan Granite and similar Rocks
9.description: Coarse-grained, white to light-gray biotite granite and biotite granodiorite. Commonly porphyritic and blocky phenocrysts of potassium feldspar and conspicuous quartz grains. Age about 102 Ma (U-Pb)

10.name: Tioga Till
10.description: Moraines usually sharp-crested with abundant boulders at surface

11.name: Bridalveil Granodiorite and similar rocks
11.description: Fine-grained hornblende-biotite granodiorite and biotite granite
11.reference: Intrusive suite of Buena Vista Crest

12.name: Quartz diorite
12.description: Dark fine-grained rock rich in hornblende. Occurs as irregular intrusive masses cross-cutting El Capitan and Taft Granites on north side of Yosemite Valley and as dikes of quartz diorite containing conspicuous phenocrysts of quartz east of Turner Ridge
12.reference: Intrusive suite of Buena Vista Crest

13.name: Granodiorite of Illilouette Creek and similar rocks
13.description: Medium-to coarse-grained mafic hornblende-biotite granodiorite, tonalite, and granite. Age about 100 Ma (U-Pb)
13.reference: Intrusive suite of Buena Vista Crest

14.name: Aplite and pegmatite
14.description: Dikes and small masses; mostly late differentiates of the Tuolumne Intrusive Suite

15.name: Tahoe Till
15.description: Moraines usually crested, but subdued, with scattered, weathered boulders at surface. Includes till mapped by some as Tenaya Till and Mono Basin Till east of Sierra Nevada crest

16.name: Metavolcanic rocks, undivided
16.description: Hornfels and other metamorphic rocks derived chiefly from sandstone, siltstone, shale, limestone, and conglomerate. Known to be of Jurassic age in Strawberry Tungsten Mine area near southeast corner of map area. Other bodies of rock assigned to this map unit are of questionable age

rule_notes: first match over major lithologies, then name, then description; volcanic with bottom age >= 145.0 Ma -> greenstone_metavolcanic; clastic sedimentary with bottom age <= 2.58 Ma -> alluvium; 'water' -> other
